items.title: A composite of localized Chern classes equals the pushforward of the restricted classes along the intersection of the W_i
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors

items.difficulty_reason: The lemma states that for X locally of finite type over a base (S, delta) as in Situation labelled situation-setup, a proper b : W -> P^1_X, closed subschemes Z_i with W_i = b^{-1}(P^1_{Z_i}), perfect objects Q_i and integers p_i >= 0 satisfying the assumptions of Lemma labelled lemma-localized-chern-pre, the vanishing of Q_i off W_i up to a rank bound, and assumption (3) of Situation labelled situation-loc-chern, the composite c'_{p_n}(Q_n) o ... o c'_{p_1}(Q_1) equals the pushforward from W_{n,infinity} cap ... cap W_{1,infinity} to Z_n cap ... cap Z_1 of the products of the restricted classes composed with the class C of Lemma labelled lemma-gysin-at-infinity (statement lines 11025-11059). The proof is an induction on n. The case n = 1 is the construction of c'_{p_1}(Q_1), using that W_{1,infinity} is the inverse image of Z_1 in W_infinity (proof lines 11061-11067). The induction step applies Lemma labelled lemma-base-change-localized-chern-pre to compute the restriction of c'_{p_n}(Q_n) to Z_{n-1} cap ... cap Z_1 through the closed subset Z_n cap ... cap Z_1 and the restriction of Q_n, observes (b')^{-1}(Z_n) = W_n cap ... cap W_1 and rewrites the restriction with the class C_{n-1} of Lemma labelled lemma-gysin-at-infinity, then reorders the composite (proof lines 11068-11106). The decisive move is Lemma labelled lemma-homomorphism-pre, which makes C_{n-1} composed with the pushforward equal to the identity on elements in the image of the Gysin map, so it suffices to show that every element in the image of the composite of the restricted classes is such a Gysin image; this is done by writing each c'_{p_i}(Q_i|_{W_{i,infinity}}) through Lemma labelled lemma-loc-chern-agree as the restriction of the bivariant class c_{p_i}(W_i -> W, Q_i) and using that bivariant classes commute with i_infinity^* (proof lines 11108-11158). Managing the induction, the base change of the localized class and the identification of the image of the composite with the Gysin image is the non-formal step, so the claim is H2.
